verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Visa publishes the Trusted Agent Protocol openly, with an open-licensed reference implementation, and aligns it with web-bot-auth and RFC 9421. However, every implementation shown (tap-agent, agent-registry, cdn-proxy, the MCP server and toolkit) is built and maintained by Visa. The only hint of outside adoption is a community comment about Visa plugging into ChatGPT, which is a single party and does not show independent protocol implementation. No two independent implementers are documented, so the ecosystem claim is not demonstrated.
